traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.text: The hurricane is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 11, +3 to hit with spell attacks). It knows the following sorcerer spells: * Cantrips (at will): blade ward, gust, light, prestidigitation * 1st level (4 slots): feather fall, jump, thunderwave * 2nd level (2 slots): gust of wind

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.text: While the hurricane is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

traits.name: Unarmored Movement
traits.text: While the hurricane is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its walking speed increases by 15 feet (included in its speed).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The hurricane makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
